title: Metric label schema
description: The metric label schema defined in The Software Field Guide, "observability-engineering": the label set is a contract — two teams emitting the same metric with different label sets produce unjoinable numbers. Every metric declares its label set explicitly (an empty array is a valid contract), and the schema is versioned like code. This schema mirrors the shape rules of the Rego validator (policies/obs); the validator additionally enforces the semantic rules a JSON schema cannot — metric names must be unique, labels unique within a metric, and the review date fresh (not future, not more than 365 days stale).

version.description: Version stamp of the schema of record, bumped by whoever last changed a label set.

reviewedOn.description: The date of the last review, YYYY-MM-DD. Must name a real calendar date, not lie in the future, and be at most 365 days before the validation date.

metrics.description: The declared metrics and their label sets.

name.description: The metric name, e.g. storefront_requests_total. Must be unique across the schema.

description.description: What the metric counts and how the labels slice it.

labels.description: The label set: the dimensions the metric is sliced by. Declared explicitly — empty means the metric is deliberately unlabeled. Anything that is not a dimension belongs in a log event, not a label.

items.description: A label name. Must be unique within the metric's label set.
